name: Context-based NeRF Compression (CNC)
definition: A compression framework for multi-resolution Instant-NGP-based NeRFs that uses context models to predict probabilities for entropy encoding feature embeddings, quantizes the rendering MLP, and compresses a binary occupancy grid, achieving significant rate-distortion improvements over prior methods.
summary: Context-based NeRF Compression (CNC) is a framework that compresses Instant-NGP NeRFs by using context models to predict entropy encoding probabilities, reducing information uncertainty unlike prior pruning methods.
